coastal.title: Nanaimo fire chief supports proposed ban on continuous flame torches — but warns it might not be effective
coastal.description: Nanaimo's fire chief says he's supportive of a proposed ban on continuous flame torches in the city, but warns that it might not be effective in reducing accidental fires or injuries for those who use them.

coastal.title: Child-care programs reopening after staffing shortage on Sunshine Coast
coastal.description: The West Sechelt YMCA Child Care Centre’s infant and toddler program will reopen in October with eight spots, down from the previous 12 spots, after a staffing shortage prompted a closure.

southeast.title: Golden reverses decision to align clocks with B.C., will match Alberta instead
southeast.description: Golden was set to be the sole community in the East Kootenay synced with B.C. after the Regional District of the East Kootenay voted for permanent mountain daylight time, in alignment with Alberta.
